title: Setup wizard has a dead wiki link on the Sensitivity Detection page
body: The sensitivity detection page links `https://github.com/MilosKozak/AndroidAPS/wiki/Sensitivity-detection-and-COB` as a source for more info, which redirects to [the old AndroidAPS repo](https://github.com/MilosKozak/AndroidAPS) since the old wiki is no longer located in that repository As far as I can tell this is the only reference to the old wiki left in the app, it probably just slipped through the cracks because nobody reported it
